rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the reply format, not the tax reading. The prompt (.classm/classm.f8880.1.prompt.txt) lists the line as "line (CLW 1)"; the reply names it "CLW 1" without the parentheses, so the class M parser found no answer. The reply's value is "blank" with the work "Skipped: the form stops at line 7", which is the source: f8880 p. 1, line 7, "Add the amounts on line 6. If zero, stop; you can’t take this credit" (the case has line 7 $0.00 and Form 1040 line 18 $0.00). The project shows $0.00, which is the true worksheet amount (Form 1040 line 18 is $0.00, Schedule 3 lines 1 to 3 are $0.00) and is not a nonzero amount on a skipped line. No numeric assertion to keep or drop.

Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column; model value dropped from the fixture (the non-chosen placement). The case (fixtures/2025/classm.json, classm.f8880.4; married filing jointly) has the spouse born after January 1, 2008 (person[spouse].sav_born false) with a $665.00 Roth IRA contribution (person[spouse].sav_roth 66500), no other contribution or distribution. f8880 p. 1, Caution: "You cannot take this credit if either of the following applies. ... The person(s) who made the qualified contribution or elective deferral (a) was born after January 1, 2008; (b) is claimed as a dependent on someone else’s 2025 tax return; or (c) was a student". The model applies the Caution on line 1(b) ("spouse is a student/dependent/born after 1/1/2008, so the Caution rule excludes it"); the project enters the contribution on line 1(b) as printed and zeroes the spouse's column on line 6(b) under amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column (owner decision 4): "On a joint return, an ineligible spouse's own column is zero (line 6 of that column), and the other spouse's column is figured as usual", chosen as f8880.line6a/6b through f8880.elig_a/elig_b. Lines 6(b), 7 and 12 are $0.00 on both readings.
